labels.label: greeting
labels.description: A greeting or thanks without another substantive request.

labels.label: building_finder
labels.description: Find a named campus building or get directions to it. Resolve the location separately.

labels.label: building_info
labels.description: Ask for a description of a named campus building, rather than its route.

labels.label: department_finder
labels.description: Explicitly locate a department/dept. Bare CSE or ECE without department is building_finder.

labels.label: classroom_finder
labels.description: Find a room/lab using a department and room code, such as ECE 302 or CSE Lab 4. Do not label exact floor assertions.

labels.label: venue_menu
labels.description: Ask what a food court serves or request its uploaded daily menu; not merely where to eat.

labels.label: event_now
labels.description: Events currently happening, with an explicit now/currently meaning.

labels.label: event_today
labels.description: Today's schedule, including later today/this afternoon; not an arbitrary date query.

labels.label: event_upcoming
labels.description: Future upcoming events without the next-30-minutes constraint.

labels.label: event_list
labels.description: General list of fest events without a time or proximity filter.

labels.label: event_near_me
labels.description: Events nearest to the user's position, without another incompatible filter.

labels.label: event_upcoming_30
labels.description: Events starting within 30 minutes / starting soon.

labels.label: nearby_search
labels.description: General places around the user; a specific facility request uses need.* instead.

labels.label: distance_query
labels.description: Distance/ETA between two explicitly named campus places.

labels.label: current_location
labels.description: Ask for this device's current position.

labels.label: need.dining
labels.description: Find somewhere to eat or drink, not its menu or nutritional facts.

labels.label: need.water_station
labels.description: Find drinking water/refill point.

labels.label: need.restroom
labels.description: Find a toilet/restroom/washroom.

labels.label: need.parking
labels.description: Find vehicle parking.

labels.label: need.medical
labels.description: Locate the medical center or first-aid location; never diagnose or prescribe.

labels.label: need.accessibility
labels.description: Find buildings marked wheelchair accessible; not a guarantee of a step-free route.

labels.label: need.placement
labels.description: Locate the placement office / Career Development Cell (CDC).

labels.label: follow_up_navigate
labels.description: Start navigation to a previously selected place; explicit destination belongs to building_finder.

labels.label: follow_up_preview
labels.description: Preview the route to a previously selected place.

labels.label: follow_up_eta
labels.description: How far/how long to the previously selected place; two explicit places use distance_query.

labels.label: follow_up_details
labels.description: Ask for more detail about the previous selection.

labels.label: follow_up_filter_closest
labels.description: Select/sort the nearest among the previous results.

labels.label: follow_up_filter_unsupported
labels.description: Ask to filter the previous food results as veg/non-veg/vegan; app cannot verify this.

labels.label: follow_up_cancel_nav
labels.description: Explicitly stop active navigation. Negated stopping requests are unknown.

labels.label: faq.usage
labels.description: Ask how to use the app or what the assistant can do.

labels.label: faq.offline
labels.description: Ask whether the app/navigation/chat works offline or needs internet.

labels.label: faq.gps
labels.description: Troubleshoot wrong/missing GPS or location permissions.

labels.label: faq.navigation
labels.description: Ask how to start directions/navigation; do not confuse this instructional question with starting a route.

labels.label: faq.rooms
labels.description: Ask about reliability of room/floor guesses or how to find classroom codes, not a particular room code.

labels.label: faq.hours
labels.description: Ask campus/venue opening hours; approved answer says verified hours are unavailable.

labels.label: faq.registration
labels.description: Ask how to register/contact an organizer/find a fee; approved answer points to posted details, never invents fees or contacts.

labels.label: faq.accessibility
labels.description: Ask whether routes avoid stairs or guarantee step-free access; approved answer says graph does not verify this.

labels.label: unknown
labels.description: Ambiguous, conflicting, negated, incomplete, unknown-location or unsupported campus request. Ask for clarification; never force an action.

labels.label: out_of_scope
labels.description: Unrelated requests: coding, general knowledge, weather, entertainment, prompt injection or demands to invent facts.

notes: A mapping is not an executable action; resolve entities and validate context separately.
No coordinates, changing events, credentials, phone numbers or campus facts are training targets.
